name: Tile::reblendNeighbourhood
purpose: Calls Tile::blendFaceTextures on this tile with its own type (+m_type) and with -1 on each existing neighbour (+0x34 array: n0, n2, n1, n3) and on the four diagonals reached through two neighbour links (n0->n2, n1->n2, n1->n3, n0->n3), skipping any NULL link
